scripts._comment_postinstall: Re-applies patches/@keystatic+astro+5.2.0.patch, which wraps that package's read of Astro.locals.runtime.env — removed in Astro 6, and under workerd it throws, 500ing every /api/keystatic/* request. REMOVE when @keystatic/astro supports Astro 6; re-generate with `npx patch-package @keystatic/astro` if you bump the version. Without this script the CMS is broken in production only, which is the worst place to find out.
scripts.dev:container: container run --name plcc-dev --detach --rm --env ASTRO_CONTAINER_DEV=1 --publish 4321:4321 --mount type=bind,source="$PWD",target=/workspace --tmpfs /workspace/node_modules --workdir /workspace docker.io/library/node:lts sh -lc "npm ci && npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4321"
scripts._comment_clean:vite: Vite's SSR dep cache goes stale across Astro/adapter upgrades and surfaces as 'The file does not exist at node_modules/.vite/deps_ssr/...'. Anything that loads the Astro config through Vite hits it, so both `build` and `check` clear it first rather than each carrying its own copy of the rm.
scripts._comment_clean: Every derived directory in one place, for when a build goes strange. All four are gitignored and regenerate on the next build.
scripts._comment_prebuild: Clears the stale dep cache, then generates public/_redirects from the short-links collection so astro build copies it into the deploy.
